MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Students' Book, page 74.

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: One. Five P's live together in a pod.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 一群，住在同一个窝里。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Will we live here forever? Asked one P.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 我们这里能永远住下去吗？P．问：

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: No. We'll grow bigger and stronger.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 不。我们会长大变得更强壮。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Then one day, we'll leave this pod and see the world. answered another
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 然后有一天，我们离开这个罐子，看看世界。回答另一个问题

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: P.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 字母 P。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Two. The P's grew bigger and bigger.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: P的叶子变大了

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: One day, a boy picked the pod. We'll soon see the world! said the P's.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 有一天，一个小男孩摘下了一个果子。我们很快就会看到世界！说的P的。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: They were very excited.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 他们非常兴奋。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Three. The boy took the P's out of the pod.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 三。那个男孩把P从果子里拿了出来。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: You'll make good bullets! he said.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 你会打得很棒！他说。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Four. I'll see the world! said the first P.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 我将去世界！

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: I'll fly to the sun! said the second P.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 我要飞到太阳上！第二P说的。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: The third and the fourth P's were lazy.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 第三和第四颗P很懒。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: We're happy anywhere. We only want to sleep. they said.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 我们说，我们想去睡觉的地方。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: The fifth P said. I'll do something useful.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 第五P说：我会做些有用的事。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Five. One by one, the P's flew into the sky.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 五。一只只P飞进天空。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Six. The first P fell on a roof, and a bird ate it.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: Six. 第一个P 落在一个屋顶上，一只鸟吃了它。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: The second P fell into some water.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 第二颗P掉进水里了。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: The third and fourth P's fell into a yard, and two chickens ate them.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 第三和第四颗P掉进了一个院子，两只鸡吃了它们。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: The fifth P hit a window and fell on the ground.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 第五P撞破窗户摔到地上。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Soon, it grew into a plant with some green leaves.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 不久，它长成了一株有几片绿叶的植物。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Seven. A girl was ill. She looked out of her window and saw the plant.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 七。一个女孩生病了。她透过窗户看到植物。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: The P is growing bigger and taller. It must be strong.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: P正在变大和更高。它必须强壮。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: I'll try to do the same. she said.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 我也会做同样的事。她说。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: A few weeks later, the girl got well. her mother said.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 几天后，女孩康复了。妈妈说：

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.english: Thank you little P.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNDgxOTQ0.chinese: 谢谢你，小彼得。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: Then one day we'll leave this pod and see the world answered another pea.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 然后有一天我们就会离开这个盒子，看看外面的世界。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: The peas grew bigger and bigger.
One day a boy picked the pod.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 有一天，一个小男孩摘了果子。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: the boy took the peas out of the pod.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 那个男孩把豆子从豆荚里取了出来。
你会把盒子打开，读你的愿望。
我们无论在哪里都很开心。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: The fifth piecea said I'll do something useful.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 第五块面包说我会做一些有用的事情。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: the peas flew into the sky.
The first pea fell on a roof and a bird ate it.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 第一颗豌豆落在屋顶上，一只鸟把它吃了。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: The second pea fell into some water.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 第二颗豌豆掉进了水里。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: The third and fourth peas fell into a yard.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 第三和第四颗豌豆掉进了一个院子

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: The fifth pea hit a window and fell on the ground.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 第五颗豌豆落在窗台上掉到了地上。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: Soon it grew into a plant with some green leaves.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 很快它长成了一株植物，有些绿叶。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: She looked out of her window and saw the plant.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 她透过窗户看见了植物。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.english: The pea is growing bigger and taller.
I'll try to do the same,
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzY3.chinese: 我会试着做同样的事情，
